pages.raw_title: We Are Compass Minerals | Enhancing Lives Around The World
pages.raw_meta: For almost two centuries, Compass Minerals has provided essential minerals that enhance the lives of people around the world. Learn more about us.
raw_blocks: THIS IS WHAT WE BELIEVE IN
Our Core Values drive everything we do. Each and every day they keep us grounded in the past and focused on the future.
We are Compass to the Core.
We uphold the highest ethical standards, operating with fairness and transparency in all that we do.
We are dedicated to fostering a diverse, safe and inclusive environment where everyone is treated with dignity.
We believe in the power of teamwork, achieving more together through cooperation and mutual support.
We are committed to delivering exceptional results for our customers and shareholders while responsibly managing the resources entrusted to us.
We strive for excellence through initiative, accountability and delivering superior results.
The leadership at Compass Minerals is dedicated to excellence, innovation, sustainability and delivering long-term value to the company.
View an illustrated history of Compass Minerals.
With our success comes a daily commitment to safety, diversity and integrity, as well as a profound responsibility for stewardship of the environment.
Compass Minerals has 11 production and packaging facilities throughout the U.S., Canada and the U.K.

As a company, we’re intentional about what we value. That allows us to make sure every interaction people have with us represents who we truly are at our core. And because we’re clear about those values, we’re sharing them with you here.

pages.raw_title: Leading Producer of Salt, Plant Nutrients, and Magnesium Chloride | Compass Minerals
pages.raw_meta: Compass Minerals produces salt, plant nutrients, and magnesium chloride for distribution in the United States and Canada.
raw_blocks: Compass Minerals is a leading global provider of essential minerals, including salt, sulfate of potash and magnesium chloride. We also provide secure records storage in a retired section of an underground mine in the U.K. Products from Compass Minerals serve a variety of applications in consumer, industrial, chemical and agricultural markets.
Compass Minerals is the largest U.S. producer of magnesium chloride.
Compass Minerals provides plant nutrients for improved yield and consistent crop quality.
We’re the leading salt producer in North America and the United Kingdom.
Our DeepStore Records Management reflects our focus on sustainability.
